document.note: Post of 19 August 2026 on the IDF's English Telegram channel t.me/idfofficial, summarising the humanitarian response since the ceasefire. The archived copy is Telegram's public embed view of the post.

quote: More than 21,000 tons of medical equipment have entered the Gaza Strip since the beginning of the ceasefire.
caveat: Published by the IDF; the post does not name COGAT, the MoD unit that coordinates the crossings and that the superseded row credited (via the Jerusalem Post). The superseded row dated it 12 August. Not independently verified.
